hints.title: Determining Line Position from Extremes
hints.text: The vertical reflection axis is locked at the midpoint of the minimum and maximum horizontal coordinates across all given points.

hints.title: Exact Integer Coordinate Sum Invariant
hints.text: For any point (x, y), its mirrored reflection must be located at (min_x + max_x - x, y). Avoid floating point division by comparing doubled coordinates.

hints.title: Hash Set Lookup for Mirrored Points
hints.text: Deduplicate points into a set. Find min_x and max_x. For each (x, y) in the set, verify that (min_x + max_x - x, y) is also present in the set.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear O(N) time and linear O(N) auxiliary space using a hash set.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing arbitrary vertical reflection lines without fixing extremes yields quadratic or infinite search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set enables O(1) membership verification for candidate reflection partners.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle duplicate points gracefully by deduplicating points prior to checking.
